title: Campanato spaces via quantum semigroups
summary: In this paper, we continue to investigate Campanato spaces via semigroups on von Neumann algebras. One of the main results is their coincidence with Lipschitz spaces for {\it all} regularity indices $α> 0$ and for all {\it analytic} semigroups on von Neumann algebras {\it not necessarily being finite}; the desired self-improving property of Campanato spaces has also been verified. As a consequence, we demonstrate that the column Campanato spaces are isomorphic to the row ones for {\it all} $α> 0$.
